project.name: Flight Simulator
project.description: Browser-based 3D flight simulator built with Three.js — procedurally generated terrain, realistic flight physics, and a chase camera, now with full touch controls for phones and tablets.

changelog: added: on-screen touch controls for phones and tablets — virtual joystick for pitch/roll plus FIRE, LOCK, and BRAKE buttons
added: settings and help menu (gear button) listing all controls, with automatic touch detection
added: crashes now deliver a violent two-stage shake — a sharp impact jolt, then a low structural rumble with a roll twist
added: every explosion — missile hits, ground impacts, enemy kills — rattles the camera, with force fading smoothly over distance
changed: faster impacts hit harder — crash shake scales with impact speed, from a gentle bump to a full slam
changed: ground features appear twice as frequently, so flying at cruise speed feels dramatically faster
fixed: orbiting the camera around the plane no longer causes terrain-loading stutter or frame drops
fixed: terrain-loading deadlock resolved — terrain falls back gracefully instead of freezing or leaving chunks invisible
fixed: sharper, clearer image at better frame rates — antialiasing and the cinematic look now run in a single pass
fixed: smoother frames during explosions and dogfights from general CPU optimisations
